### Observed differences

- In the earlier window, A41 (present in every trace) was followed by one of four alternative activities — about 28 in 100 of its outgoing transitions went to A14, 26 to A15, 26 to A20 and 20 to A21 — and each of the four always led directly into A22, which ran two steps after A41. In the later window, A41 leads directly to A22 in all observed transitions. [DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, DIR008, LAG004]
- The four alternatives still occur at similar rates (A14 in about 28% of traces before vs 27% after, A15 26% vs 24%, A20 26% vs 22%, A21 20% vs 27%; the shares sum to about 100% in both windows, consistent with exactly one of them per case), but their relative position moved from about one third into the trace (means about 0.32) to about 0.60. [POS001, POS002, POS003, POS004]
- Their order relative to A22 and A23 reversed: earlier, each of the four always ran before A22 and A23 when it occurred (e.g., A14 before A22 in 28% of traces, never the reverse); in the later window, A22 and A23 always run first (e.g., A22 before A14 in 27% of traces, never the reverse). [REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007, REL008]
- The successors of the four changed from always A22 to roughly half A24 and half A28 (e.g., A14: 100% to A22 before; about 52% to A24 and 48% to A28 after). [DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005]
- The A23–A28 segment changed: earlier, A23 was always immediately followed by A24 and A24 immediately by A28 (A23 to A28 always two steps). In the later window, about 52% of A23's outgoing transitions go to A24 and about 48% to one of the four (A14 ~14%, A21 ~13%, A20 ~12%, A15 ~10%); about 48% of A24's go to A28 and about 52% to one of the four; one event now separates A23 from A24 in about 48% of traces and A24 from A28 in about 52%, while A23 to A28 is always three steps — consistent with exactly one of the four sitting between A23 and A28 in every trace. [DIR006, DIR007, LAG001, LAG002, LAG003]
- A22 and A23 each shifted slightly earlier (mean relative position about 0.35 to 0.32 and 0.59 to 0.56), matching the loss of one event before them. [POS005, POS006]
- In a separate part of the process, the shares of A03's outgoing transitions to A04 fell from about 40% to about 22%, while those to A09 rose from about 21% to about 35% (A05 roughly stable at 39–43%). [DIR001]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis that the group of alternative activities A14, A15, A20 and A21 — of which each case executed exactly one — is now executed after A23 instead of before A22: earlier, A41 was followed by one of the four, which always led into A22, after which A23, A24 and A28 followed in fixed adjacency; in the later window, A41 leads straight to A22, and the single alternative activity is inserted in the A23–A28 segment, directly after A23 in about 48 in 100 traces or directly after A24 in about 52 in 100. The order reversal is shown directly by the relation items, the rerouting by the direction items, and the insertion points by the lag items, while the participation rates of the four stayed roughly stable, so this is not a mere shift in how often existing paths are taken; with 26 qualifying items against fewer than one expected if nothing had changed, and every difference larger than in about 995 of 1000 random re-splits, chance sampling cannot account for the pattern as a whole. [DIR002, DIR006, DIR007, DIR008, LAG001, LAG002, LAG003, LAG004, POS001, POS004, REL001, REL008]

The evidence covers outgoing transitions and pairwise relations rather than complete models, so it cannot distinguish a relocation of the same step from the early occurrence being removed and a same-labelled step inserted later, and A22's own outgoing transitions are unobserved, leaving the A22-to-A23 connection inferred; whether the choice of insertion point (after A23 vs after A24) follows a rule or chance cannot be determined from these windows. [DIR006, DIR007, DIR008, LAG002]

Other differences: at A03, outgoing transitions shifted away from A04 (about 40% to about 22%) towards A09 (about 21% to about 35%); this routing change is independent of the hypothesis above. [DIR001]
